name: GramClaw
tagline: Telegram outreach and team inbox with a remote MCP connector for Claude.
description: GramClaw helps teams run personalized Telegram campaigns from their own accounts and manage replies in a shared inbox with CRM-style organization. Its remote MCP server lets Claude search chats and contacts, send messages, and manage campaigns; every MCP write waits for one-click approval inside GramClaw. A REST API is also available for direct integrations. Solo starts at €49 per month with a 7-day trial.
